senses.gloss:
घ्रंसः, घ्रंस्- /ghraṃsaḥ/ /ghraṃs-/ 

ghraṁsáḥ, ghráms- m. Sonnenglut / heat of the sun,
= breton. groez, grouez Sonnenhitze, vgl. air. grīs Feuer, zu ghļņoti.

घ्राणम् /ghrāṇam/ 

ghrānam n. Geruch, Nase / smell, nose, ghrāņā f. dss.
(s. ghonā), vgl. toch. A krāṁ Nase, B kor Kehle, zu jighrati.

घ्रातिः /ghrātiḥ/ 

ghrātiḥ f. Geruch, Riechen / smell, smelling, = gr.
Őo-gonois Geruch, zu jighrati.
